author: Seung Wook
problem: weights lists the weights in milligrams of coins from a mint's production line. A coin passes inspection if it is no more than tol milligrams heavier or lighter than target. Return how many coins pass.
bug_description: Uses abs(w - target) < tol instead of <= tol, so a coin that is off by exactly the tolerance is rejected.

comments.accurate: Coins whose weight is within the tolerance of the target
comments.wrong_behavior: Coins weighing strictly inside the tolerance band around the target
comments.wrong_location: Tolerance check verified; check that both heavy and light coins are measured by their distance from target
